summary.text: Tedizolid phosphate (NDA 205435) was granted Qualified Infectious Disease Product (QIDP) designation under the GAIN Act for ABSSSI and HABP/VABP, which conferred priority review and an additional five years of marketing exclusivity. The Anti-Infective Drugs Advisory Committee met March 31, 2014 and voted unanimously 'Yes' on substantial evidence of safety and effectiveness; the application was approved first cycle based on two Phase 3 noninferiority trials versus linezolid, with pediatric and antimicrobial resistance surveillance postmarketing requirements.

citations.quote: tedizolid tablets and powder for injection were granted Qualified Infectious Disease Product designation and therefore this application was granted a priority review. QIDP designation qualifies tedizolid for an additional five years of marketing exclusivity.
The Anti-Infective Drugs Advisory Committee of the Food and Drug Administration, Center for Drug Evaluation and Research, met on March 31, 2014.

All committee members voted “Yes”, indicating that the applicant provided substantial evidence of the safety and effectiveness of tedizolid phosphate for the treatment of acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections caused by susceptible isolates of the designated microorganisms.
Therefore, non-inferiority of tedizolid phosphate to linezolid is demonstrated in both Study TR 701-112 and Study TR 701-113.
